abstract_sentences.text: Differentiable model predictive control (MPC) offers a powerful framework for combining learning and control.

evidence.anchor: combining learning and control

abstract_sentences.text: However, its adoption has been limited by the inherently sequential nature of traditional optimization algorithms, which are challenging to parallelize on modern computing hardware like GPUs.

evidence.anchor: inherently sequential nature ... challenging to parallelize

abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we tackle this bottleneck by introducing a GPU-accelerated differentiable optimization tool for MPC.

evidence.anchor: GPU-accelerated differentiable optimization tool

abstract_sentences.text: This solver leverages sequential quadratic programming and a custom preconditioned conjugate gradient (PCG) routine with tridiagonal preconditioning to exploit the problem’s structure and enable efficient parallelization.

evidence.anchor: custom preconditioned conjugate gradient

abstract_sentences.text: We demonstrate substantial speedups over CPU- and GPU-based baselines, significantly improving upon state-of-the-art training times on benchmark reinforcement learning and imitation learning tasks.

evidence.anchor: speedups over CPU- and GPU-based baselines

abstract_sentences.text: Finally, we showcase the method on the challenging task of reinforcement learning for driving at the limits of handling, where it enables robust drifting of a Toyota Supra through water puddles.

evidence.anchor: robust drifting of a Toyota Supra

reported_results: qualitative speedup over CPU/GPU differentiable-solver baselines
robust Toyota Supra drifting through water puddles

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把 differentiable MPC 的 forward OCP solve 与 backward sensitivity 统一为 KKT/IFT 线性系统，再用 Schur complement、symmetric stair preconditioner、PCG、time parallelism 和 warm-start 放到 GPU，最后以 RL/IL timing 与 domain-randomized drifting 验证工具链。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: OCP/KKT/IFT/VJP、SQP/PCG 主机制、Figure 2、Figure 3–8、4× speed claim、RL/IL compatibility、20-rollout simulation success、14-hour application training 和主要限制。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Algorithm 3–4、line-search constants、baseline modifications、six-problem timing、gradient/warm-start diagnostics、cart-pole dynamics、vehicle/randomization/deployment details、Figures 11–13。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Eq. (8)–(11) 与 Figure 2/Algorithms 1–2 形成 KKT → Schur → PCG/preconditioner → parallel recovery → learning interface 的连续数据流；Table 3 在 appendix 补足多 problem mean/2σ。
final_judgment.largest_gap: PCG/preconditioning/warm-start 对 GPU speed 的独立因果效应没有 matched removal 或 Riccati control；inequality constraints、gradient discontinuity、initialization divergence 缺少直接实验；hardware external validity 主要是 qualitative/one-trial。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 系统型 differentiable-optimization 论文应让 forward objective、backward sensitivity、结构化线性代数、部署数据流由同一组公式/算法闭合，并为每个性能主张标出设备、问题族、重复单位和误差表达。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 当训练路径、部署 solver、约束处理或硬件条件不同，结论应拆成数值 benchmark、模拟闭环与硬件示范三个范围，不能用单一 speed 或 success 数字覆盖它们。
